description: Optional evidence-backed AI visibility recommendations. Flat price from cite42_pricing per completed AI report; insufficient evidence and rule-only fallback are free. Supports rankings, compare, citations and sentiment, including usable workflow steps. No crawling, fresh research, keyword advice or tracker activation. Covers AI-search, citation, SEO, keyword, trend, and market-research data. If a plan needs more than 20 endpoint calls or may use more than $5 USD, estimate the cost in USD and ask the user before continuing. Quote Cite42 costs and balances in USD using cite42Billing or the USD pricing table. Legacy credit fields are for compatibility only. These funds belong to Cite42, not the host or model provider. AI visibility metrics include counts; quote them with percentages, not as a market-wide score. Optional recommendations are a separate paid call, never automatic. After a visibility result, offer recommendations using its requestId; run only when the user requests advice and knows the additional cost. Free: cite42_balance for the remaining balance, cite42_pricing for exact per-tool prices and cost estimates, cite42_usage for recent calls.
